title: Houmoon
description: An AI wellbeing app, tested with about 100 internal users and closed in 2026 before any public release.
body: The [Houmoon archive](/houmoon/) records the product, its timeline and the public company record.\n\nHoumoon Ltd, company number [15622617](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/15622617), was incorporated in the United Kingdom on 6 April 2024 and dissolved on 12 May 2026.
